data.description:
## Context / Problem

Every GitHub Copilot CLI session started in this checkout fails at load with:

```
Failed to connect to MCP server "serena": failed to initialize MCP client:
transport failure during send initialize request: the server closed its input
stream (broken pipe)
```

Two independent defects combine:

1. **Wrong scope.** Serena is the only MCP server this repo relies on that is *not*
   project-scoped. `.mcp.json` today declares exactly one server, `mcpServers.rebar`
   (verified by reading the file; `tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_client_configs.py:107`
   indexes `doc["mcpServers"]["rebar"]`). Serena instead lives in the machine-local
   user config `~/.copilot/mcp-config.json`, so it loads in every directory on the host
   and is invisible to the repo. This contradicts the project-scoping precedent set by
   closed ticket `irregular-basic-bubblefish` and documented at
   `docs/mcp-client-setup.md:84-88` ("Copilot CLI 1.0.83 loads workspace `.mcp.json`
   before `.github/mcp.json` and lets workspace entries override user-level entries, so
   the rebar server is scoped to this checkout instead of every directory on the host").

2. **A launch command that cannot run in Copilot's MCP sandbox.** The entry launches
   `uvx --from git+https://github.com/oraios/serena serena start-mcp-server`. `uvx`
   re-resolves the git HEAD and rebuilds the package on *every* launch. Copilot sandboxes
   MCP servers (`sandbox.sandboxMcpServers` is enabled in `~/.copilot/settings.json`), and
   uv's build step shells out to `git init`, which cannot read `~/.gitconfig` inside that
   sandbox. Captured verbatim from `~/.copilot/logs/process-1789493292635-48702.log`:

   ```
   × Failed to download and build `serena-agent @ git+https://github.com/oraios/serena@704e8c3d`
   ├─▶ Git operation failed
   ╰─▶ process didn't exit successfully: `/opt/homebrew/bin/git init` (exit status: 128)
       --- stderr
       fatal: unable to access '/Users/joeoakhart/.gitconfig': Operation not permitted
   ```

   uv aborts, the child exits before reading stdin, and the client sees a broken pipe on
   `initialize`. The failure is deterministic, not intermittent: it reproduced on every
   session start and again in a controlled headless run.

Serena is not optional tooling here — `AGENTS.md` §"Navigating the codebase" mandates it
for semantic navigation and documents that it reads a read-only mirror of `origin/main`
rather than the live checkout. While it is down, every agent silently falls back to `grep`,
which `docs/code-navigation.md` documents as failing in the opposite direction.

## Approach

Point the entry at an **already-installed** serena binary instead of building from git at
launch, and move the entry into the project config.

Installing once with `uv tool install --from git+https://github.com/oraios/serena
serena-agent` produces a stable executable at
`~/.local/share/uv/tools/serena-agent/bin/serena` (confirmed on this host; it resolves
`serena-agent==1.7.1.dev0`). That path removes git and the network from the startup path
entirely, which is what fixes the bug: the sandbox never invokes `git init`, so
`~/.gitconfig` is never touched. It is also the reason to prefer this over the alternatives
— it is the only option that makes startup independent of a remote ref, so the server
cannot break again when upstream HEAD moves. Upgrades become a deliberate
`uv tool upgrade serena-agent` instead of an implicit rebuild on every session.

Two facts make the entry safe to commit to a shared, tracked file:

- Copilot expands `${HOME}` in both `command` and `args` of a project `.mcp.json`. This was
  verified empirically, not assumed: a scratch project whose `command` was
  `${HOME}/scratch/mcp-probe/bin/probe.sh` logged
  `LAUNCHED cmd=/Users/joeoakhart/scratch/mcp-probe/bin/probe.sh args=start-mcp-server
  --context ide-assistant --project /Users/joeoakhart/.rebar-serena-mirror`, so both fields
  expand. The same mechanism already serves `${MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CLI}` in the committed
  `rebar` entry.
- No sandbox policy change is required. `~/.local/share` and `~/.rebar-serena-mirror` are
  already in `sandbox.userPolicy.filesystem.readwritePaths`, and serena's only git call
  (`serena/util/git.py:get_git_status`) is wrapped in a bare `except:` that returns `None`,
  so the sandbox's `~/.gitconfig` denial is harmless at runtime.

Record the one-time install in `docs/mcp-client-setup.md` beside the existing Copilot
section, and add a regression test asserting the committed entry never reverts to a
git-build launcher.

## Scope

- `.mcp.json` — add `mcpServers.serena` (`type: local`, command
  `${HOME}/.local/share/uv/tools/serena-agent/bin/serena`, args `start-mcp-server
  --context ide-assistant --project ${HOME}/.rebar-serena-mirror`, `tools: ["*"]`); extend
  the existing `$comment` array to record why the entry must not use `uvx --from git+`.
- `docs/mcp-client-setup.md` — under the existing `## Copilot CLI` section (line 82
  onward), document the serena entry, the one-time
  `uv tool install --from git+https://github.com/oraios/serena serena-agent`, and the
  `~/.rebar-serena-mirror` prerequisite.
- `tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_client_configs.py` — add one test over the committed
  `.mcp.json`.

The change is purely additive to `.mcp.json`. The existing tests index
`doc["mcpServers"]["rebar"]` by key (lines 107-118) and `test_no_secret_committed` scans the
file text for a `Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9+/=_.-]{16,}` literal; a serena entry adds no bearer and
no new top-level key, so neither is disturbed.

Out of scope: the machine-local removal of the stale user-level entry (`copilot mcp remove
serena`) and the per-developer `uv tool install`. Those are host actions, not repository
files.

## Testing

New test `test_serena_entry_is_prebuilt_not_git_build` in
`tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_client_configs.py`, loading the committed `.mcp.json`:

- Happy path: `doc["mcpServers"]["serena"]["type"] == "local"`, its `command` ends with
  `/bin/serena`, and its `args` contain `start-mcp-server`.
- Failure/regression path — the assertion that actually encodes this bug: the serialized
  entry contains neither `uvx` nor `git+`. Concretely, reverting `command` to `"uvx"` with
  args `["--from", "git+https://github.com/oraios/serena", …]` must fail this test.

Because this is a cutover of a live client integration, a live end-to-end check is part of
acceptance rather than a unit test: a real headless `copilot -p` run in this checkout, with
its log inspected for connection failures.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `.mcp.json` declares `mcpServers.serena` as a `type: local` server whose `command` is
      `${HOME}/.local/share/uv/tools/serena-agent/bin/serena`; checked by
      `pytest tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_client_configs.py -k serena` exiting 0.
- [ ] The committed serena entry contains neither `uvx` nor `git+`, so no session start can
      trigger a git build; checked by the same test's regression assertion.
- [ ] Serena is workspace-scoped, not user-scoped: `copilot mcp list` run from the repo root
      lists `serena` under `Workspace servers`, and the same command run from `$HOME` does
      not list it at all; checked by running both and pasting the two outputs into a ticket
      comment.
- [ ] A live headless `copilot -p` run inside this checkout initializes serena: the session
      log for that run contains zero occurrences of `MCP server connection failed` and at
      least one `server_info: Some(Implementation { name: "Serena"`; checked by
      `grep -c` on the log file named in a ticket comment.
- [ ] `docs/mcp-client-setup.md` names the one-time
      `uv tool install --from git+https://github.com/oraios/serena serena-agent` and the
      `~/.rebar-serena-mirror` prerequisite; checked by `grep -n "uv tool install"
      docs/mcp-client-setup.md` returning a match.
- [ ] `[non-codebase]` The change is uploaded to Gerrit as a reviewable change; evidence is
      the change number and its `Change-Id`, recorded in a ticket comment. The pipeline is
      known-blocked this session, so `LLM-Review +1`/`Verified +1` and Submit are explicitly
      out of scope for this ticket.
data.title: Serena MCP server fails to start under Copilot: user-scoped entry rebuilds from git at launch, and `git init` is blocked by the MCP sandbox
